scientific_integrity: All infinite conclusions have analytic proofs. Finite exhaustive computations are corroborative. A previously published unrestricted spectrum theorem is explicitly used and credited. Full-text access limitations are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The eleven-spectrum classification concerns atomic theories with precisely two raw noun variables, complements, and finite nonempty universes. It does not classify theories with noun-level union or arbitrary sentence-level disjunction. Historical-priority comparison with the 2016 finite-model chapter is limited to accessible abstract and bibliographic material; its full text could not be inspected.
title: Eleven spectra, sixty-seven atomic types, and a sharp seven-element bound in two-noun cardinality syllogistic
